items.desc: AI assistant and MCP server for Blender: visual chat, scene tools, multi-agent workflows. Works with OpenAI, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, OpenCode. Blender AI addon and plugin, copilot for 3D, bpy Python scripting, MCP integration.

An inference framework customized for AI MAX 395, compatible with both Linux and Windows, and supports deploying only qwen3.8-flash-next. This project is for reference and learning purposes only. 为AI MAX 395定制的推理框架，Linux和Windows通用，只能部署qwen3.8-flash-next。本项目仅供参考学习使用。
